subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded-runtime `sessions_spawn` mitigation while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92271 continues tracking gateway loopback, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn coverage?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent for the embedded path, but automation cannot choose whether the partial fail-closed fallback policy is acceptable before the broader delegation surfaces are covered.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Land this PR after normal exact-head checks and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining spawn/delegation surfaces.

options.title: Require One Shared Policy First
options.body: Hold this PR until the same fallback completion-announcement policy is enforced across OpenClaw work-spawning tools and the Codex-native boundary is resolved or explicitly excluded.

options.title: Split Follow-Ups Before Merge
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers create owner-backed follow-up items for each uncovered surface, then land the embedded guard as the first slice.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Land this PR after normal exact-head checks and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining spawn/delegation surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and already framed the cross-harness scope requirement this decision turns on.
